text:
alex kim: FYI I merged the patch for CVE-2026-0482 in kv-client (v2.3.5 -> v2.3.6). Can folks run the post-patch smoke and perf checks?

maria gonzalez: on it. I'll kick off the canary and run the quick latency tests.

ben choi: thanks. checklist?

alex kim: quick checklist: 1) canary rollout to 2% on dedicated infra, 2) run health + kvcache smoke, 3) run 15m perf profile (p95/p99), 4) verify kube events and no RBAC audit errors, 5) confirm KMS decrypt logs unchanged.

sre-bot: Deploy job started: canary-rollout/kv-client-v2.3.6 -> 2% on ded-gpu-pool. job_id=dr-4392

maria gonzalez: canary started. running smoke script now:
```bash
./scripts/postpatch-smoke.sh --service kv-client --checks health,kvcache,decode --target canary
```

maria gonzalez: smoke results:
```
HEALTH: OK (200 x100)
KVCACHE: OK (prefix cache hit 87%)
KMS-DECODE: OK (decrypt success 100%)
ERRORS: 0 new errors
```

sam rawlings: running perf harness (short run) against canary pods now. will report p50/p95/p99 token latency.

ben choi: watching kube events and audit log pipeline. grep for "rbac" and "permission denied".

security-ops: quick note: audit-collector ingestion is up to date; forwarding to SIEM active. will watch for new denied actions.

maria gonzalez: perf snapshot (run id perf-190101): p50 28ms, p95 132ms, p99 270ms. baseline (v2.3.5) p95 138ms p99 282ms. small improvement at p95.

sam rawlings: memory/CPU stable. no OOMs. cpu usage +3% typical, tail latency slightly improved. graphs: https://grafana.internal/d/pkKv/kv-client?orgId=1&from=now-30m&to=now

ben choi: kube events: no RBAC denies, only normal rollout events. audit logs show KMS decrypt entries unchanged schema.

alex kim: nice. any errors from canary pods? logs?

maria gonzalez: scanned logs for 15m: only expected WARN about slow batch 1. small spike during config reload at 1901012390. not correlated with user requests.

sre-bot: Canary health check reports: 2/2 pods ready, 0 restarts, success rate 99.9% over last 10m.

security-ops: SIEM shows no increase in suspicious KMS calls. RBAC audit counts consistent.

alex kim: ok let's advance to 25% for 30m and re-evaluate. keep the perf harness running.

sre-bot: Triggering canary-scale: 2% -> 25%, job_id=dr-4393

maria gonzalez: scaling now. I'll post another perf snapshot after 30m.

ben choi: flagging rollback steps in case: kubectl rollout undo, scale down canary service, and revoke artifact from registry if needed.

sam rawlings: note to recorder: run the full 1h perf job after 25% is stable. also include KV cache hit heatmap.

alex kim: thanks everyone. if no regressions after 30m at 25% we'll do full rollout. I'll update the incident channel if anything odd. :thumbsup:

maria gonzalez: ack.

security-ops: adding final verification checklist to the change ticket: KMS decrypt counts, RBAC denies (0), p95 within +-10% baseline, no new error groups.

alex kim: thread done for now, will reopen if we see anomalies."
